about.title: Head Volleyball Coach
about.bio: I've spent years developing players from beginner club levels through varsity competition, focusing on the technical precision and team awareness that win matches. Every session is designed to sharpen your most critical skills and make you a more dangerous player.

hero.headline: Touch. Set. Attack.
hero.subline: Private volleyball coaching — serving mechanics, setting precision, and attacking development for players who want to dominate the net.

services.title: 1-on-1 Skills Training
services.description: Personalized sessions targeting your position — serving mechanics, passing, setting, or attacking based on where you need to grow.

services.title: Setting & Ball Control
services.description: Dedicated sessions for setters and liberos — hand position, footwork, decision-making, and platform control under pressure.

services.title: Attacking & Defensive Development
services.description: Approach mechanics, arm swing, reading blocks, and defensive footwork for outside hitters, middles, and opposite.

faq.question: What age groups do you train?
faq.answer: We work with players from U10 through college level. Sessions are adapted to skill level — beginners and advanced players both welcome.

faq.question: Where do sessions take place?
faq.answer: Training takes place at local gym facilities in the area. Location is confirmed at booking.

faq.question: How long are sessions?
faq.answer: 1-on-1 sessions run 60 minutes. Small group sessions are 90 minutes.

faq.question: What should my player bring?
faq.answer: Court shoes, knee pads, and water. A volleyball is helpful if you have one — equipment is provided.

faq.question: Do you train all positions?
faq.answer: Yes — I work with setters, liberos, outside hitters, middles, and opposite hitters. Sessions are always position-specific.
